name: Images
about: Concept art, character sheets, posters and textures, drawn by FLUX on NVIDIA's free API - the route behind AMAL's best pictures. AMAL writes the art-director prompt, makes several, judges them and keeps the best.

settings.label: Default style
settings.tip: the look added to every prompt

settings.label: Versions per picture
settings.tip: AMAL makes this many and keeps the best

settings.label: Retakes
settings.tip: new rounds when none is good enough

settings.label: ComfyUI address
settings.tip: the GPU machine's ComfyUI, for video, music and 3D

templates.name: Pixel sprite
templates.gives: one character or item in crisp pixel art, square, three takes
templates.tip: pixel art with a limited palette and a clean outline - for a 2D game's characters, items and enemies

templates.name: Sprite to cut out
templates.gives: one subject alone on plain white, full body, ready to cut out
templates.tip: a painted game asset with no scenery and no ground shadow - for sprites, cards and inventory art
templates.prompt: a health potion in a round glass bottle

templates.name: Character sheet
templates.gives: front, side and back of one character, same proportions
templates.tip: a design sheet in a neutral pose on a flat background - what an artist or modeller works from
templates.prompt: a dwarf blacksmith with a braided beard and a leather apron

templates.name: 3D reference
templates.gives: one subject drawn to be modelled: every part shown once, limbs clear
templates.tip: a modelling reference with little perspective - the picture the 3D line builds from
templates.prompt: a wooden treasure chest with iron bands

templates.name: Environment concept
templates.gives: a wide painted scene with mood and depth, 16:9
templates.tip: cinematic concept art for a level, a biome or a key location
templates.prompt: a ruined watchtower on a cliff above a foggy pine forest

templates.name: Tiling texture
templates.gives: a square surface that repeats without a seam, flat light
templates.tip: top-down, no shadows, no objects - for terrain, walls and materials

templates.name: Key art
templates.gives: a tall cover picture with room for the title at the top
templates.tip: a store capsule, poster or cover - one strong focal point
templates.prompt: a lone knight facing a dragon at the mouth of a cave

templates.name: Game concept
templates.gives: painterly fantasy concept art, dramatic light, three takes
templates.tip: the house look for ideas, pitches and mood pictures
templates.prompt: a goblin market inside a hollow tree
